summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reprinted the Leavenworth Commercial's notice of Tom Allen's sparring exhibition at the Leavenworth Opera House, where a large crowd came to see him ahead of his McCoole rematch.

metadata.notes: masthead: Daily Democrat, Tuesday Morning, August 31, 1869

facts.fact: Allen gave a sparring exhibition at the Opera House in Leavenworth, Kansas, to a large crowd
Allen's backers predicted an easy victory over McCoole

notes: Commercial of the 29th describes the exhibition on the preceding night.
